meta.name: anndata
meta.description: Data structure for annotated matrices in single-cell analysis. Use when working with .h5ad files or integrating with the scverse ecosystem. This is the data format skill—for analysis workflows use scanpy; for probabilistic models use scvi-tools; for population-scale queries use cellxgene-census.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读入并组织单细胞测序产生的注释矩阵,为下游分析打好基础。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果处理单细胞测序结果,需要按注释矩阵整理基因表达数据。
copy.tagline_en: Read and organize annotated single-cell matrices for downstream analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you handle single-cell sequencing data and need a standard way to organize annotated expression matrices.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按 AnnData 的结构创建、读写和操作带注释的矩阵对象,处理 .h5ad、zarr 等文件里的 obs/var 元数据、稀疏矩阵与大数据 backed 模式,还能合并多个数据集。
howto.when: 当你处理 .h5ad、zarr 等注释矩阵文件,或要合并、切分、读写单细胞数据集时触发;分析流程与概率模型分别交由 scanpy、scvi-tools 等技能负责。

say.text: 帮我把这个 .h5ad 文件读进来,看看维度和元数据
say.note: 会以只读方式打开并输出对象结构

say.text: 把这几个 h5ad 批次合并成一个数据对象,并加上批次标签
say.note: 用 ad.concat 合并并记录 batch 来源

say.text: 把这个 100GB 的 h5ad 用 backed 模式打开,只保留高质量细胞
say.note: 惰性读取后按元数据筛选再载入内存

howto.what_en: Claude can create, read, write and manipulate annotated matrices in .h5ad, zarr and other formats, handle obs/var metadata, sparse matrices and backed mode, and concatenate datasets.
howto.when_en: Use it for .h5ad or zarr files, single-cell data work, and merging or subsetting datasets; analysis workflows and probabilistic models belong to scanpy and scvi-tools skills.

say_en.text: Read this .h5ad file and show its shape and metadata
say_en.note: Opens the object read-only and prints its structure

say_en.text: Concatenate these h5ad batches into one object with batch labels
say_en.note: Uses ad.concat and records the batch keys

say_en.text: Open this 100GB h5ad in backed mode and keep high-quality cells
say_en.note: Lazy read, then filter on obs metadata
